```{r}
#| include: false
root <- rprojroot::find_root(rprojroot::has_file("renv.lock"))
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
for (f in setdiff(list.files(file.path(root, "R"), pattern = "[.]R$"), "_dependencies.R")) source(file.path(root, "R", f))
source(file.path(root, "studies", "301", "tlf", "tlf_common.R"))
source(file.path(root, "studies", "201", "tlf", "tlf_201.R"))
source(file.path(root, "studies", "201", "analysis", "cui.R"))
d <- targets::tar_read(csr_201_data, store = file.path(root, "_targets"))
p <- d$protocol
s <- d$sap
b <- csr_blinding(d$unblinded)
lock <- yaml::read_yaml(file.path(root, "docs", "lock", "dblock-201.yml"))
asis <- function(x) cat(x, sep = "\n")
table_md <- function(id) asis(csr_table(d$tables[[id]]))
figure_md <- function(id) asis(csr_figure(id, d$files, root))
adsl <- d$adsl
n_rand <- sum(adsl$RANDFL == "Y")
n_saf <- sum(adsl$SAFFL == "Y")
n_comp <- sum(adsl$EOTSTT %in% "COMPLETED")
n_disc_study <- sum(adsl$EOSSTT %in% "DISCONTINUED")
pct <- function(n, N) sprintf("%d (%s%%)", n, formatC(100 * n / N, format = "f", digits = 1))
doses <- purrr::map_dbl(p$arms, "dose_mg")
mcp <- s$primary$mcp
td <- s$primary$mod$target_dose
a1 <- d$analysis$a1
s1 <- d$analysis$s1
s2 <- d$analysis$s2
target_text <- function(x) if (is.null(x) || is.na(x$target_dose)) "no dose" else dose_label_201(x$target_dose)
w <- clinical_utility_weights_201(s)
```

tables and figures are those of the pipeline (`docs/sap/fjf-2026-201-outputs.yml`), embedded
unchanged.

# Synopsis

| | |
|---|---|
| Study | `r p$study`, phase `r p$phase` |
| Title | `r p$title` |
| Design | Randomised `r paste(unlist(p$randomisation$ratio), collapse = ":")`, stratified by `r p$randomisation$stratification[[1]]$factor`. `r p$randomisation$blinding` |
| Treatments | `r paste(purrr::map_chr(p$arms, "label"), collapse = "; ")` |
| Duration | `r p$treatment_weeks` weeks of treatment, `r p$follow_up_weeks` weeks of follow-up |
| Patients | `r n_rand` randomised (planned `r length(doses) * d$sample_size`), `r n_saf` treated |
| Primary endpoint | Change from baseline in HbA1c at week `r p$primary_visit_week` (hypothetical estimand E1), analysed by generalised MCP-Mod |
| Database lock | `r substr(lock$locked_at, 1, 10)` (tag `dblock-201`, frozen commit `r substr(lock$frozen_commit, 1, 7)`) |
| Status | `r if (b$blinded) "**Blinded**: results by arm use dummy arms" else "Unblinded"` |

# Ethics

The study is simulated: there are no patients, investigators or ethics committees. The
protocol's ethical content is written as for a real study and reviewed in the protocol synopsis.

# Introduction

FJF-2026 is a fictional once-daily oral glucose-lowering drug, studied here added to metformin.
`r trimws(p$dose_rationale)`

```{r}
}
```

## Selection of patients


## Treatments, randomisation and blinding

Patients were randomised `r paste(unlist(p$randomisation$ratio), collapse = ":")` to placebo or
FJF-2026 `r paste(doses[doses > 0], collapse = ", ")` mg, within strata of
`r p$randomisation$stratification[[1]]$factor`.
`r p$randomisation$blinding`. **Discontinuation.** `r trimws(p$discontinuation$rule)`

**Blinding of the analysis.** Until the database lock, and after it until the reviewer
authorises the unblinding, the pipeline uses a dummy assignment: the real arms shuffled within
each stratum with a public seed (ADR 0027, ADR 0032). SDTM, ADaM, the analyses and every output
were programmed and checked on the dummy arms.

# Statistical methods

The methods are those of the frozen SAP (tag `sap-201-v1.0`); every setting below is read
from `docs/sap/fjf-2026-201-sap.yml`, the same file the analysis code reads.

## Analysis sets and derivations

```{r}
#| results: asis
asis(csr_markdown(purrr::map_dfr(s$analysis_sets, function(a) {
  data.frame(Set = a$label, Definition = trimws(a$definition), Use = a$use)
})))
asis(c(trimws(s$derivations), ""))
```

## Primary analysis: generalised MCP-Mod (A1)

- **Data:** `r trimws(s$primary$data)`
- **Model:** `r trimws(s$primary$model)` If it does not converge, the covariance structures
  `r paste(unlist(s$primary$covariance_fallback), collapse = ", ")` are tried in turn.
- **MCP step:** `r trimws(mcp$contrasts)` One-sided alpha `r format(mcp$alpha_one_sided)`, HbA1c
  `r mcp$direction`.

```{r}
#| results: asis
cand <- purrr::map_dfr(mcp$candidate_models, function(m) {
  guess <- setdiff(names(m), "model")
  data.frame(
    Model = model_label_201(m$model),
    Guesstimate = if (length(guess) == 0) "none" else paste(sprintf("%s = %s", guess, unlist(m[guess])), collapse = ", ")
  )
})
asis(csr_markdown(cand))
```

- **Mod step:** `r trimws(s$primary$mod$selection)`
- **Target dose:** `r trimws(td$rule)`

## Clinical utility index (X1, exploratory)

```{r}
#| results: asis
x1 <- purrr::keep(s$exploratory, function(x) x$id == "X1")[[1]]
asis(c(
  trimws(x1$method), "",
  sprintf(paste(
    "Details fixed before the unblinding (ADR 0031): the HbA1c effect is the fitted effect of the",
    "A1 selected model at each dose (the MMRM difference from placebo if no model is selected);",
    "the safety component is the share of the safety set, by dose taken, with a treatment-emergent",
    "adverse event leading to withdrawal of the drug; each is scaled linearly over the doses, 1 for",
    "the best and 0 for the worst; the index is %s × effect + %s × safety."
  ), format(w[["effect"]]), format(w[["safety"]])), ""
))
```

## Sample size

`r d$sample_size` patients per arm, chosen for at least `r formatC(100 * s$sample_size$target_power, format = "f", digits = 0)`%
power of the MCP step under every candidate model. In the dry run of the SAP
(`r nrow(d$oc)` simulated trials on planning values), a dose-response signal was found in
`r formatC(100 * mean(d$oc$signal), format = "f", digits = 1)`% of the trials.

# Data management and quality

## From the raw data to the outputs

The raw (EDC-like) data are loaded once into PostgreSQL with an audit trail, checked against
`docs/specs/raw-layer.yml`, cleaned by the rules of `docs/specs/cleaning-rules.yml`, mapped to
SDTM and derived to ADaM by the programs of FJF-2026-301 with this study's specifications
(ADR 0030), in the same reproducible pipeline.

```{r}
#| results: asis
q <- d$raw_quality
found <- q[q$n > 0, ]
asis(c(sprintf("The raw-data quality checks ran %d checks; %d found records, handled as the cleaning rules say:", nrow(q), nrow(found)), ""))
if (nrow(found) > 0) {
  asis(csr_markdown(data.frame(Check = found$check, Table = found$table, Records = found$n, Detail = found$detail)))
}
```

## Second programming

```{r}
#| results: asis
qc <- d$qc
qc$clean <- ifelse(qc$clean, "Agree", "**Differ**")
asis(csr_markdown(qc, c("Level", "Units", "Compared", "Result")))
```

## CDISC conformance

Pinnacle 21 Community and CDISC CORE were run on the SDTM and ADaM packages; the findings, a
subset of those of FJF-2026-301, are explained in `studies/201/conformance.md`.

## Database lock

The database was locked on `r substr(lock$locked_at, 1, 10)` by `r lock$locked_by`, after the
second programmings agreed. Programs, specifications and cleaning rules are frozen at commit
`r substr(lock$frozen_commit, 1, 7)` (tag `dblock-201`). Decisions taken before the lock:
ADR 0030 and ADR 0031 (the lock file names ADR 0028, as explained in ADR 0031).

# Efficacy: dose-response

```{r}
#| results: asis
asis(b$results_note)
```

In the MCP step of A1 a dose-response signal was `r if (a1$signal) "found" else "not found"`
(smallest adjusted p `r p_301(min(a1$mct$adjusted_p))`). The Mod step selected
`r if (is.na(a1$model)) "no model" else model_label_201(a1$model)`, and the target dose was
`r target_text(a1)`. Model averaging (S1) gave `r target_text(s1)`, and all observed values
(S2) gave `r target_text(s2)`.

```{r}
#| results: asis
table_md("T-14.2.1")
table_md("T-14.2.2")
figure_md("F-14.2.1")
```
